  run: Invoke-DbaQuery -SqlInstance $Ci -Database ScratchCopy -File $Migration
- name: Fail on a destructive change without an explicit flag
  run: pwsh ./scripts/check-destructive-changes.ps1
- name: Warn on a new query with no supporting index
  run: pwsh ./scripts/check-missing-indexes.ps1
